item.description:
# Splash Finish 0.3.14
- A refreshed inbox window from the shared bobuk.io component library, BobukKit: a rounded frame with an amber accent line, matching Ting and Lowkey. - Shortcut hints at the bottom of the inbox now show each key next to its action. Each hint stays together and moves to a new line when space is limited. - Notification cards, links, pi questions, keyboard commands, light and dark themes, and Increased Contrast work as before.
Your inbox, settings and agent integrations are retained. Homebrew copies update with **Update Splash Finish via Homebrew…**; standalone copies update with **Check for Updates…**.
